system_overview.name: Jaimini Astrology
system_overview.author: Maharishi Jaimini
key_principles: Chara Karakas determined by planetary degrees
Special aspect rules different from Parashari
system_overview.primary_focus: Soul evolution, destiny patterns, and karmic fulfillment

chara_karakas.description: Movable significators determined by degree within sign. The 7 planets (excluding Rahu/Ketu) are ranked by their degrees, with highest becoming Atmakaraka.
chara_karakas.calculation_method: Sort planets by rashi_degree (degree within sign) in descending order

atmakaraka.remedy: Focus on the planet serving as AK - strengthen through mantras, gemstones, and conscious alignment with its qualities

jaimini_aspects.description: In Jaimini astrology, signs aspect other signs (not planets aspecting planets as in Parashari)
jaimini_aspects.rule: Every sign aspects the 5th, 8th, and 11th signs from itself
jaimini_aspects.counting_method: Count inclusively: from Aries (1st), 5th = Leo, 8th = Scorpio, 11th = Aquarius
jaimini_aspects.interpretation: When a sign aspects another, planets in the aspecting sign influence the house/planets in the aspected sign

arudha_padas.description: Arudha means 'reflection' or 'image'. Arudha Padas show the perceived reality or external manifestation of each house's significations.
arudha_padas.calculation: From house sign, count to its lord's position, then count same distance from lord's position
special_rules: If lord is in the house itself, pada falls in 10th from house
If pada falls in same house or 7th from it, shift to 10th from house

a1.name: Arudha Lagna (AL)
a1.importance: Most important Arudha Pada - shows worldly success and perception

a7.name: Dara Pada
a7.importance: Very important - shows marital happiness and partnership success

a10.name: Karma Pada/Rajya Pada
a10.importance: Shows professional success and public recognition

karakamsha_interpretations.description: Karakamsha is the Navamsha (D9) position of the Atmakaraka. It reveals the soul's ultimate purpose and karmic direction.

aries.interpretation: Dynamic soul with leadership karma. Purpose involves initiating new ventures, pioneering work, and courageous action. May have military, sports, or entrepreneurial inclinations.
aries.spiritual_path: Karma Yoga through action and leadership

taurus.interpretation: Soul seeks stability and material security. Purpose involves creating lasting value, artistic expression, and financial acumen. Strong attachment to comfort and beauty.
taurus.spiritual_path: Bhakti through devotion to beauty and harmony

gemini.interpretation: Communicative soul with intellectual karma. Purpose involves writing, teaching, commerce, and connecting people. Versatile but may scatter energy.
gemini.spiritual_path: Jnana Yoga through knowledge and communication

cancer.interpretation: Nurturing soul with emotional karma. Purpose involves caring for others, home-making, and emotional intelligence. Strong family and ancestral connections.
cancer.spiritual_path: Bhakti through devotion to family and ancestors

leo.interpretation: Royal soul with authority karma. Purpose involves creative self-expression, leadership, and gaining recognition. Natural confidence and dignity.
leo.spiritual_path: Raja Yoga through self-mastery and nobility

virgo.interpretation: Service-oriented soul with perfectionist karma. Purpose involves healing, analysis, and practical problem-solving. Attention to detail and refinement.

libra.interpretation: Diplomatic soul with relationship karma. Purpose involves creating balance, harmony in partnerships, and aesthetic pursuits. Strong sense of justice.
libra.spiritual_path: Finding balance between self and others

scorpio.interpretation: Transformative soul with intense karma. Purpose involves deep research, occult knowledge, transformation, and healing. Powerful but secretive nature.

sagittarius.interpretation: Philosophical soul with dharmic karma. Purpose involves higher learning, teaching, travel, and spiritual guidance. Natural optimism and wisdom-seeking.

capricorn.interpretation: Disciplined soul with achievement karma. Purpose involves building structures, organizational mastery, and taking responsibility. Patient but ambitious.

aquarius.interpretation: Humanitarian soul with innovative karma. Purpose involves serving humanity, scientific advancement, and collective welfare. Unconventional thinking.
aquarius.spiritual_path: Seva (service) to humanity and universal consciousness

pisces.interpretation: Spiritual soul with moksha karma. Purpose involves compassion, spiritual liberation, artistic expression, and transcendence. Natural psychic and healing abilities.
pisces.spiritual_path: Bhakti and meditation leading to moksha (liberation)

sign_mobility.description: Jaimini classifies signs into three categories based on their inherent nature

movable.aspect_rule: Movable signs aspect all fixed signs (except adjacent)

fixed.aspect_rule: Fixed signs aspect all movable signs (except adjacent)

dual.aspect_rule: Dual signs aspect other dual signs

chara_dasha.description: Sign-based dasha system where each rashi rules for a period determined by the distance between the sign and its lord

odd_footed_lagna.order: Lagna → next sign → ... → completing all 12 signs

even_footed_lagna.order: Lagna → previous sign → ... → completing all 12 signs

duration_calculation.method: Count houses from the sign to its lord's position
duration_calculation.special_case: If lord is in the sign itself, duration = 12 years

interpretation_guidelines: Sign and its lord give the overall theme
Planets in the sign activate their significations
Aspects to the dasha sign modify results
Arudha pada of the sign shows external manifestation
Timing of events follows sub-dasha (Antar dasha) within each sign period
